summary: Four recently retired railroaders from Lincoln, Nebraska, high-centered their Jeep Wrangler in 3-4 ft of snow on a trail west of Idaho Springs around 2pm; after failed self-digs and calls to local authorities, team met at Kum & Go Idaho Springs and reached them at 6:45pm, winched out and led down the mountain after dark
location: trail west of Idaho Springs, near Georgetown/Hwy 103 junction
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue and Recovery; Clear Creek County Sheriff's Office
notes: Client story says "April 4th, 2018" explicitly. Four 2WD-era retired railroaders facing a long cold night in the mountains. Sheriff referred them to the volunteer team.
